Test channel: trying ZORA 2.0.1 (e0243e2). For races and normal play, use zora.gg.

Beta settings are on. They're less tested, so some bugs are to be expected. If you encounter a bug, report it in the ZORA Discord with the text from the "Copy bug report info" button.

Zelda One Randomizer App

A newly re-imagined randomizer for The Legend of Zelda
Your ROM is read in this page only and is never uploaded

How will you play?
1

Get the ZORA world

Archipelago builds the multiworld from every player's YAML. It needs ZORA's world file, zora.apworld, and a PRG0 or PRG1 ROM on the computer that patches your game. This page only makes your YAML: no ROM is needed here.

zora.apworld
The download link appears once the page has loaded.
